title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Low
shortDescription: Injector circuit voltage for cylinder 1 is below expected.
fullDescription:
P0261 sets when the ECM detects the injector control circuit for cylinder 1 is reading lower voltage than the calibrated threshold.

This often indicates a short to ground in the injector wiring or a failed injector driver inside the ECM. The cylinder may misfire or run rich/lean depending on driver behavior.
safetyImpact: May cause misfire and reduced power; safe to drive short distances.

causes.cause: Short to ground in injector wiring

fixSteps.title: Scan and confirm
fixSteps.instruction: Read all DTCs and freeze frame data.

fixSteps.title: Inspect injector connector
fixSteps.instruction: Check connector and wiring at cylinder 1 injector.

fixSteps.title: Test injector resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Measure injector coil resistance against spec.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector
fixSteps.instruction: Replace injector if out of spec.

faq.q: Can I drive with this code?
faq.a: Short distances only; misfires can damage the catalytic converter.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit High
shortDescription: Injector circuit voltage for cylinder 1 is above expected.
fullDescription:
P0262 indicates the injector control circuit for cylinder 1 is reporting higher than expected voltage. Typical causes are an open circuit, short to voltage, or failed injector.

The affected cylinder will misfire and the engine may stumble or run lean.
safetyImpact: Misfire and emissions impact; address promptly to protect catalyst.

fixSteps.title: Scan and confirm
fixSteps.instruction: Read all DTCs and freeze frame data.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Check for open circuit at cylinder 1 injector.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector
fixSteps.instruction: Swap injector with known-good unit.

faq.a: The control wire is reporting higher voltage than the ECM commanded — usually an open circuit.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit/Open
shortDescription: Generic injector circuit fault on cylinder 1.
fullDescription:
P0263 is a general injector circuit fault for cylinder 1, set when the ECM cannot verify proper operation of the injector control circuit. May indicate open, short, or intermittent fault.

Diagnostic priority: confirm wiring integrity before replacing the injector.
safetyImpact: Misfire risk; reduced power and emissions impact.

fixSteps.title: Scan codes
fixSteps.instruction: Pull DTCs and look for related cylinder codes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Look for chafed wiring near the injector.

fixSteps.title: Swap injector
fixSteps.instruction: Move injector to another cylinder to see if code follows.

faq.a: No — diagnose first. Wiring is more often the cause than the injector.
